layout.notes: There is no status column, so the status vocabulary is empty. Derive status from the data. A unit with no tenant, no dates and Remarks 'VACANT - asking' is vacant. The total row 96 has the unit count as text '92 units' in B96. Row 97 is blank and row 98 is a disclaimer note. Column A (No) is a serial number. Title is in A1 and no as-of date appears in the sheet; the filename says Oct 26. Shops G01-G04 are retail units.

discrepancies.title: OM income AED 3,945,000 vs in-place rent AED 3,762,000

sources.label: rent roll in-place rent, 88 let units
rent roll in-place rent plus asking rent on 4 vacant units

discrepancies.why: The OM figure is not contracted income: it equals the rent roll's in-place rent plus asking rent on 4 vacant units (AED 3,945,000). The screen underwrites let units at their contract rent and vacant units at the screen reference rent after downtime. Gross yield on price falls from 11.6% to 11.1% on in-place rent.

impact.basis: OM stated income above rent-roll in-place rent

discrepancies.analyst_action: Ask for signed leases or Ejari certificates behind any unit the OM counts as income; treat the rest as vacant.

discrepancies.title: Operating statement omits property management, insurance, sinking fund
discrepancies.why: A whole-building owner bears these costs; the screen fills each from the mandate default per sq ft of NSA (the management fee is always the mandate's % of EGI). From the statement's NOI of AED 3,086,004 to the screen's Year-1 NOI of AED 2,706,468: income: rent-roll leases modelled lease by lease, net of re-letting downtime, vs statement income + AED 116,504; structural vacancy top-up and collection loss (house view), vs statement losses less AED 65,709; management fee at the mandate rate on EGI, vs the stated fee less AED 187,428; insurance: absent from the statement, mandate default less AED 59,417; sinking fund: absent from the statement, mandate default less AED 148,542; leasing fees on modelled turnover less AED 25,036; irrecoverable input VAT on costs less AED 9,910.

discrepancies.title: Unsupported 'below market' and 'resilient rents' marketing claims

sources.quote: URGENT SALE - owner relocating, priced below market
sources.label: verified quote

sources.quote: Rents have been more resilient than prime areas in 2026.
sources.label: verified quote

discrepancies.why: The OM gives no comparable sales or rent evidence for 'priced below market' or for rent resilience in 2026. The same OM says all details come from the owner and the buyer must verify them. The urgency framing should not support the price. The 11.6% ROI is already covered by the rule-based findings.
discrepancies.analyst_action: Ignore the 'below market' framing. Benchmark the price per sq ft and the rents against recent DLD transactions and Ejari data for International City. Check the 2026 rent trend independently.

notices.text: Tenants' security deposits of AED 196,725 transfer to the buyer and must be credited at closing.
Cheque profile: 30% of rent on 1-2 cheques, 37% of rent on 3-4 cheques, 33% of rent on 6 or more cheques. More cheques mean more collection risk and less post-dated cheque cover.

diligence_checklist.text: Title deed and DLD ownership search: freehold status, single title, and that the buyer is eligible to own the plot.
Building completion certificate (Dubai Municipality) for the as-built building.
Affection plan and permitted use: confirm residential use and the plot's permitted floors match the building.
Ejari export for every lease, reconciled to the rent roll unit by unit.
Civil Defence completion and annual fire-safety certificates, and ACP cladding compliance.
Building condition survey and capex plan for a building of this age (MEP, lifts, facade, waterproofing).
Retail leases: permitted use, trade licences and VAT treatment of shop rents.

memo.markdown:
## Verdict
**Needs work**: the unlevered IRR of 6.6% [[uw.unlevered_irr_pre_tax]] is under the 7.5% [[mandate.target_unlevered_irr.threshold]] target at the asking price. Every hard mandate filter passes.

Buy at AED 30.8m [[uw.walk_away_price_aed]], exit at 8.5% [[uw.exit_yield]]. That is 9% below asking [[uw.walk_away_vs_asking]]. The assumption that moves the walk-away price most is the reference rent path (5% [[uw.walk_away_most_sensitive]] either way), which swings it by AED 4.0m [[uw.walk_away_largest_swing_aed]]. The walk-away price and the returns rest on the firm's house view (reference rents, exit yield, vacancy, downtime), not on market evidence for this building.

## The deal
- **What and where:** International City Phase 1, England Cluster, Dubai. 92 units [[om.unit_count]], G+4, completed 2008 [[deal.completion_year]].
- **Price:** asking AED 34.0m [[deal.asking_price_aed]], which is AED 687 per sq ft [[uw.price_per_sqft_nsa]] of NSA and AED 556 per sq ft [[uw.price_per_sqft_bua]] of BUA.
- **Income:** in-place rent AED 3.8m [[rr.in_place_rent_aed]] on direct leases, with no master tenant. Occupancy is 96% [[rr.occupancy_by_units]]: 88 units let [[rr.let_units]] and 4 vacant [[rr.vacant_units]]. The largest expiry window holds 32% [[uw.max_expiry_share_quarter]] of rent, between 31 July 2027 [[uw.max_expiry_window_start]] and 30 October 2027 [[uw.max_expiry_window_end]].

## Returns
| Metric | Deal | Mandate |
|---|---|---|
| Unlevered IRR, pre-tax | 6.6% [[uw.unlevered_irr_pre_tax]] | 7.5% [[mandate.target_unlevered_irr.threshold]] minimum: fails |
| Unlevered equity multiple | 1.32x [[uw.unlevered_equity_multiple_pre_tax]] | 1.30x [[mandate.target_unlevered_equity_multiple.threshold]]: passes |
| Entry yield on price | 8.0% [[uw.entry_yield_on_price]] | none |
| Exit yield | 8.5% [[uw.exit_yield]] | none |
| Going-in net yield on total cost | 7.5% [[uw.going_in_net_yield_on_cost]] | 6.0% [[mandate.min_going_in_net_yield_on_cost.threshold]]: passes |
| Year-1 NOI | AED 2.7m [[uw.noi_year1]] | none |

Levered, pre-tax: IRR 6.3% [[uw.levered_irr_pre_tax]], multiple 1.32x [[uw.levered_equity_multiple_pre_tax]], Year-1 DSCR 1.63x [[uw.dscr_year1]].

The OM's headline yield is 11.60% [[uw.om_yield_summary]], on asking price with the basis not stated. On a buyer's basis (Year-1 NOI on price plus acquisition costs) it is 7.49% [[uw.om_yield_summary]], which is 4.1 points [[uw.om_yield.gap_vs_stated]] lower.

## What would make it fail
- **Rents:** with market rent 5% [[uw.sens.rent_shift_step]] lower at the base exit yield, unlevered IRR is 5.5% [[uw.sens.r-5.e+0.unlevered_irr_pre_tax]]. If the exit yield is also 50 bps [[uw.sens.exit_shift_step_bps]] wider, it is 4.5% [[uw.sens.r-5.e+50.unlevered_irr_pre_tax]] and levered IRR is 2.8% [[uw.sens.r-5.e+50.levered_irr_pre_tax]].
- **Exit:** at base rent, an exit yield 50 bps [[uw.sens.exit_shift_step_bps]] wider gives 5.6% [[uw.sens.r+0.e+50.unlevered_irr_pre_tax]]. Only a tighter exit yield clears the target at base rent, at 7.6% [[uw.sens.r+0.e-50.unlevered_irr_pre_tax]]. The base case depends on a house-view exit yield.
- **Expiry cluster:** AED 1.2m [[uw.max_expiry_window_rent_aed]] of in-place rent expires in one three-month window. It is inside the mandate limit but is the main re-letting exposure.
- **Costs:** the operating statement omits several standard costs. The screen's Year-1 NOI is well below the statement's.

## Discrepancies
Lower-severity items are not discussed.
1. **OM income includes vacant-unit asking rent (high).** The OM shows AED 3.9m [[om.annual_rent_stated]] against AED 3.8m [[rr.in_place_rent_aed]] contracted. The OM figure adds asking rent on the vacant units. The screen used the rent roll. Income is overstated by AED 183k [[disc.potential_rent_as_income.impact_aed]].
2. **Costs missing from the statement (high).** Property management, insurance and sinking fund are absent. The screen filled insurance at AED 59k [[uw.opex_default.insurance]] and sinking fund at AED 149k [[uw.opex_default.sinking_fund]] from mandate defaults, and applied the mandate management fee. NOI moves from AED 3.1m [[bridge.statement_noi_aed]] on the statement to AED 2.7m [[bridge.screen_noi_year1_aed]] in the screen, a drop of AED 380k [[disc.missing_opex_items.impact_aed]].
3. **Yield before acquisition costs (medium).** The OM's 11.6% [[disc.yield_excludes_acquisition_costs.title]] is on asking price, before acquisition costs of 6.2% [[uw.acquisition_costs_pct_of_price]]. Restated on total cost the yield is 0.7 points [[disc.yield_excludes_acquisition_costs.impact_ratio]] lower.

## Checks before diligence
- Get signed leases or Ejari certificates behind any unit the OM counts as income. Treat the rest as vacant.
- Request the missing bills: Empower/chiller, insurance schedule, reserve study, management agreement.
- Ask the broker to restate yield on total cost. Benchmark price per sq ft and rents against DLD and Ejari data, and ignore the "below market" framing.
- The rent roll date is inferred from the file name, so confirm it.
- Tenants' security deposits of AED 197k [[uw.security_deposits_aed]] transfer to the buyer and must be credited at closing.
- A large share of rent is paid on six or more cheques, which means more collection risk. Review the cheque profile.
- Title deed and DLD ownership search.
- Dubai Municipality completion certificate.
- Affection plan and permitted use.
- Ejari export reconciled to the rent roll unit by unit.
- Civil Defence certificates and ACP cladding compliance.
- Condition survey and capex plan for the building's age.
- Retail leases: permitted use, trade licences, VAT treatment.

## Assumptions
House view: the exit yield of 8.5% [[uw.exit_yield]] is the higher of the area yield and the entry yield, plus 25 bps [[assume.exit_yield_expansion_bps]] of expansion and an age premium. Hold is 5 years [[uw.hold_years]]. Market rent falls 1.0% [[assume.rent_growth_year1]] in Year 1 and is flat at 0.0% [[assume.rent_growth_year2]] in Year 2. It then rises 2.0% [[assume.rent_growth_year3]], 3.0% [[assume.rent_growth_year4]] and 3.0% [[assume.rent_growth_year5]]. Structural vacancy is 5.0% [[assume.structural_vacancy]], collection loss 1.0% [[assume.collection_loss]] and renewal probability 70% [[assume.renewal_probability]]. The loan is AED 15.3m [[uw.loan_aed]] at 45% [[uw.ltv]] LTV and 6.8% [[uw.interest_rate]] interest, sized at 1.40x [[assume.sizing_dscr]] cover. Insurance and sinking fund are mandate defaults because the package lacked them.
